title: Platform rollout switches
description: Turn platform-wide capabilities on or off without a developer. Each community still controls its own settings underneath.
load_failed: The platform switches could not be loaded.
save_failed: That change could not be saved.
how_it_works_body: A switch here sets the ceiling for the whole platform. A community only gets a capability when it is on here AND switched on in that community's own settings, so turning something on here never enables it for anyone by itself. Reverting a switch hands the decision back to the server configuration.
switches_desc: Changes take effect immediately across the platform.
installed_desc: Ticketing, agenda, offline check-in, broadcasts, registration forms, invitations, safety evidence and federation delivery are reported as "Available" on each community's Event settings page. Those are not switches — they show that the feature is installed, which depends on the database, so they cannot be turned off from a screen.
confirm_enable_title: Turn this on across the platform?
confirm_enable_body: {{capability}} becomes available to every community that has it switched on in their own settings. You can revert this at any time.
capability_attendance_credits_desc: Lets verified event attendance award time credits, funded by the community's own treasury. Off means no credits can be created by any community, whatever their own settings say.
capability_recurrence_v2_desc: The newer engine for repeating events, with per-occurrence edits that survive changes to the series.
capability_rolling_recurrence_desc: Keeps generating future occurrences of a repeating event on a schedule, instead of creating a fixed set once.
capability_recurrence_definition_bluepri: Lets an organiser preview and version a change to a repeating series before applying it.
capability_timed_waitlist_offers_desc: When a place frees up, offers it to the next person on the waitlist for a limited time before passing it on.
